protocol.mode0: Cold full projection, title ascending, cap50 /25000 records
protocol.mode1: Cold compact view, duration permutation(i*193)%25000, cap50
protocol.mode2: Cold compact view, descending duration input, cap50 (replacement-heavy)
protocol.mode3: Cold compact view, descending duration input, cap1023 (replacement-heavy)
protocol.mode4: Cold compact view, ascending duration input, cap50 (no-replacement control)
protocol.timedRegion: Only Query/QueryView calls; result validation, hashing and destruction are outside each timed region. Each sample sums64 fresh-engine queries.
protocol.aggregation: Per-query sample mean from64calls; pooled median of21 sample means per mode/variant, with all raw ranges and3 process medians retained.
protocol.allocationAccounting: Sum requested C++ allocation calls/bytes over64queries; peak is maximum live query C++ bytes. No RSS/private/GPU claim.
protocol.pinning: Each process requires successful one-processor affinity and verifies the resulting mask; exact mask in stderr metadata.
protocol.validation: Every individual query matches an independent full-sort prefix/count oracle; signatures and allocation identities will also be checked across variants.
limitations: Single host, three processes per variant; ranges are observations, not formal causal or statistical proof.
No CPU-frequency conversion or player comparison; wall time and C++ heap counters only.
OS/allocator overhead and process RSS are outside the allocation probe.
